name: Azim Premji Scholarship (for girl students) 2026 Cohort

rules.quote: An initiative to support girl students to pursue their college education

rules.value: Class 10 and 12 passed as regular student from a government school/college in an eligible state
rules.quote: Passed both Class 10 and Class 12 as a regular student from a government school or college in any of the eligible States or Union Territories*

rules.value: first year UG degree or diploma (2-5 years), regular, 2026-27
rules.quote: Have taken admission in the first year (for academic session 2026–27) as a regular student of a recognised undergraduate degree or diploma course (2 to 5 years duration)

Andhra Pradesh, Arunachal Pradesh, Assam, Bihar, Chhattisgarh, Delhi (NCT), Jharkhand, Karnataka, Madhya Pradesh, Manipur, Meghalaya, Mizoram, Nagaland, Odisha, Puducherry, Rajasthan, Sikkim, Telangana, Tripura, Uttar Pradesh, and Uttarakhand

rules.value: anywhere in India (government or bona fide private college/university)
rules.quote: at a government or a (credible and bona fide) private college or university, anywhere in India.

amount.text: Rs 30,000 per year for the full duration of the first UG degree or diploma
amount.quote: an annual scholarship of INR 30,000 awarded for the full duration of their first undergraduate degree or diploma course.

documents.name: Passport photograph
documents.quote: A 2X2 inch recent coloured photo of your front-face view taken in last 6 months

documents.name: Aadhaar card
documents.quote: A clear, coloured, and unedited soft copy of the front side of your AADHAAR card

documents.name: Bank passbook first page
documents.quote: A clear and unedited soft copy of the first page of your bank account passbook

documents.name: Class 10 marksheet
documents.quote: A clear and unedited soft copy of the front side of your Class 10 marksheet

documents.name: Class 12 marksheet
documents.quote: A clear and unedited soft copy of the front side of your Class 12 marksheet

documents.name: College admission proof (bonafide or fee receipt)
documents.quote: A clear and unedited soft copy of either your Bonafide Certificate OR Tuition Fee Receipt

deadline.text: Round 1 for 2026 cohort closed; Round 2 submission window 10-31 Jan 2027
deadline.quote: Application submission to be done during Round 2 (10-31 Jan 2027).
